heading: How it works
intro: CareAlert is built around one idea: the person who notices a problem shouldn't have to chase down the person who can help.

steps.title: Notice
steps.body: A caregiver, family member, or device flags a change — a missed check-in, a symptom, a fall, anything that needs attention.

steps.title: Send
steps.body: One tap sends an alert with the details that matter: what happened, how urgent it is, and who's reporting it.

steps.title: Reach
steps.body: CareAlert notifies the right care team member immediately by text, call, or app, and keeps notifying until someone responds.

steps.title: Respond
steps.body: The care team acts, and the outcome is logged automatically, so nothing gets lost between shifts or visits.
